x.description: A `tf.Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `bfloat16`, `half`, `float32`, `float64`. `int32`
constraints: x can't be a string or boolean
x must be one of tf.Tensor, bfloat16, half, float32, float64, int32
x and output must have compatible types

output.description: A `tf.Tensor`. Has the same type as `x`. @compatibility(numpy) Equivalent to np.ceil @end_compatibility
